name: nexus-commerce
description: Enterprise-grade e-commerce platform - Customer Storefront, Retailer Dashboard, Developer Dashboard

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:storefront" "npm run dev:retailer" "npm run dev:developer"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/web && npm run build -w packages/database && npm run build -w packages/api && npm run build -w packages/storefront && npm run build -w packages/retailer-dashboard && npm run build -w packages/developer-dashboard
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.typecheck: npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/web/tsconfig.json && npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/api/tsconfig.json && npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/storefront/tsconfig.json && npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/retailer-dashboard/tsconfig.json && npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/developer-dashboard/tsconfig.json
